config.notes: Curtin course pages www.curtin.edu.au/study/offering/course-{ug|pg|rs|research}-... (stored mostly in the DOMESTIC view, ?segment=dom). Key information panel: Duration ("if you study full-time. 4 years full-time"), Attendance mode, Location, Intake (study-period names: Semester 1/2, Research Term 1/2, Trimester, Extended Term, Block Session). English: course IELTS table "Overall band score N" (same in both views). Fee: only where the page carries the international block "2026 International indicative fees Indicative year 1 fee $N" (few stored pages); domestic CSP fees are never read. term_months: Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July (Curtin Kalgoorlie course guide 2026 key dates, publications.curtin.edu.au/curtin-kalgoorlie-course-guide/page/2-3, orientation 10-13 Feb / 14-17 Jul 2026, 9-12 Feb 2027); Research Term 1 = 1 Jan-30 Jun, Research Term 2 = 1 Jul-31 Dec (www.curtin.edu.au/study/applying/application-deadlines/). Trimester, Extended Term and Block Session names are not mapped (months vary by year). atlas.curtin.edu.au/singapore pages are Curtin Singapore (S$ total fees) and choose.curtin.edu.au is a marketing page; the adapter does not read fees from them.
